approval_staleness.detail: STALE / TOTAL APPROVALS: 0/0. An approval is STALE when its ledger entry's approved_record_sha256 no longer equals the record's current CONTENT digest - that is, when the record's content changed after the judgement was made. STALE IS NOT INVALID: a stale approval does not fail validation, is reported in a finding naming the record, the ledger entry and the fields that changed, and is counted here so the invalidation is visible on every run instead of surfacing months later. A stale approval is excluded from the human_approval and production_authorization numerators, because those numerators mean 'records carrying an approval that describes the bytes now on disk'; human_approval and this figure together account for every approval in the ledger, so nothing is silently dropped. Current value 0/0: the ledger at docs/artifacts/governance/approval-ledger.jsonl holds 0 entries, so there are nothing to go stale. This is a measured zero over an empty population, not a constant.

human_approval.detail: 0 of 323 records carry a properly evidenced human approval -- the numerator is 0 because NOTHING HAS BEEN APPROVED: 323 of 323 records carry human_approval_status at its no-claim value and 0 carry the grant value. This is a measured zero, not a constant and not a schema limitation. Counts a record in the numerator only if human_approval_status carries its grant value AND approval_evidence.human_approval carries all six required elements: a named individual (not a role, not a team), their declared role, independence evidence against this record's own owner_role and its current-revision author, an ISO-8601 date, the sha256 of the review packet they signed under docs/artifacts/reviews/signed/ plus that packet's own recorded record digest, and approval_ledger_ref naming this approval's entry in the append-only ledger. The approval must also be CURRENT: an entry whose approved digest no longer matches the record's content is stale, is reported and counted in approval_staleness, and is not counted here. Computed by the same predicate the validator enforces, so the figure cannot read higher than the gate permits. Denominator: every record carrying an id. 'not_required' IS NOT A GRANT AND IS NOT COUNTED HERE: it declares that the record's family has no sign-off gate, no person decided anything, and there is no approval to evidence. Current value 0 of 323 record(s) carry it and 0 carry it on a family human approval IS required for, which is rejected by human_approval_not_required_misdeclared. It is reported here so relabelling a record is visible rather than silent; the denominator is unchanged, so relabelling cannot remove a record from the measurement. NOTE IT IS NOT A REVIEW EXEMPTION: 'not_required' says no SIGN-OFF GATE exists for the family, and every record remains reviewable and most are reviewed through reviewed_by links and review records. Decision and reasoning at docs/artifacts/governance/role-and-review-policy.json#/human_approval_not_required_decision
